$schema_note: Stories (قصص وتحقيقات) identity tokens. Measured from the stories artwork: covers, locations, evidence, suspects (see IDENTITY.md §3). This identity never appears inside a Mafia match, and Mafia's inks never appear inside a story.

lamp.meaning: the investigator's room at night, lit by one brass desk lamp. Default ground.

manila.meaning: paper: the dossier, the suspect card, the clue slip. The only light surface in the whole app.

paperLine.role: ruled lines and borders on paper

amber.meaning: lamplight: the one action, highlights, the evidence tag.

amber.role: primary button fill, active tab, evidence tag

amberHi.role: highlight text, lamp core, focus ring

accents.meaning: two small accents taken from the art. Each has exactly one job.

velvet.role: the rubber stamp (سري / اتحلت / مقفولة) and the accusation button. Measured velvet #430D09 lifted for legibility.

velvetDeep.role: stamp shadow, velvet fills in art

nile.role: the night window: time-of-story chips, clock, the discussion timer track

nileHi.role: timer fill on nile, cool counterpoint text (rare)

title.use: case titles, the verdict headline, the hub title. Nothing else. Never below 22dp.

dateline.use: the dateline under every case title, Eastern Arabic digits (١٩٥٥), amberHi

figures.use: timer and action budget only (Western digits, game UI)

elevation.note: paper is the only thing that casts a shadow; everything else is flat

light.type: radial pool from a desk lamp, centred above the content

digits.storyContent: Eastern Arabic (١٢٣) inside synopsis, datelines, clues
